prompt:

2. Edit only this object so: The traveler's red dress turned ivory. Target near x37%, y60%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.

5. Edit only this object so: The tiny storm cottage gained a red roof. Target near x20%, y15%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.
